# Third-party code

`mediabunny.min.js` is Mediabunny 1.60.0 (https://github.com/Vanilagy/mediabunny), unmodified,
copied from the npm package `mediabunny@1.60.0` (`dist/bundles/mediabunny.min.cjs`).
It is licensed under the Mozilla Public License 2.0 (see `mediabunny.LICENSE.txt`).
The source code is available at https://github.com/Vanilagy/mediabunny and in the npm package.

Diari uses it only to make the smaller 720p playback copy of videos, on your own device.
